_comment: Knowledge base for src/main/ai/title-caption-prompt.js. Rewritten in #183. The previous version carried a 3-pillar / 4-driver / worked-example framework that pushed the system prompt to ~14k chars; stacking that many constraints collapsed output variety and produced averaged, generic copy — the creator accepted 3 of 31 published titles. What replaced it: a short rule set plus REAL published examples pulled from the title_caption_rounds table at call time (src/main/title-caption-log.js). The cold_start set below is used only until a creator has published enough of their own. #419 (2026-09-16): the casing/caps/crutch rules were realigned to the creator's real output — Title Case stays the only casing ban, 'insane'/'crazy' are no longer banned, and the cold-start set carries shouted words the way published titles do. Human-readable reasoning lives in caption-frameworks.md — update both together.
anti_patterns: Title Case (Every Word Capitalised). The single clearest tell of AI short-form copy. Sentence case with the key word shouted is the target.
The second clause. Writing the hook, then explaining or twisting it. Stop at the interesting part.
Spoiling the payoff in the title or caption. The hook opens the loop; the footage closes it. A line that tells the viewer how it ends removes the reason to watch.
Hallucinated detail: a game term, player name, or event the transcript doesn't support.
Leaning on the same hook word across the batch. One card can shout INSANE; three cannot.
Vague stakes: 'this changes everything' names nothing.
Over-cleverness: if the hook needs a second sentence to land, cut it.

cold_start_examples.title: He ACTUALLY hit that
cold_start_examples.caption:
NO WAY
he hit that
cold_start_examples.note: Spectacle, declared. One shouted word carries the disbelief.

cold_start_examples.title: The goalie's MOST INSANE save
cold_start_examples.caption:
HOW did he
SAVE THAT
cold_start_examples.note: Player + superlative + play. A superlative is allowed once per batch.

cold_start_examples.title: NO ONE gets past me
cold_start_examples.caption:
NO ONE
gets past me
cold_start_examples.note: The claim the footage disproves. Caps on the claim, payoff withheld.

cold_start_examples.title: I had ONE job
cold_start_examples.caption:
I had ONE job
and STILL messed it up
cold_start_examples.note: Self-roast. Shortest possible framing of a fail.

cold_start_examples.title: I celebrated WAY too early
cold_start_examples.caption:
never celebrate
BEFORE IT'S OVER
cold_start_examples.note: Overconfidence punished. The lesson stays vague enough to stay a loop.

cold_start_examples.title: This should NOT have worked
cold_start_examples.caption:
I was FULLY
guessing here
cold_start_examples.note: Surprise at your own success. Opens a loop without naming the outcome.
